description: Every Saturday till Election Day we have a West Greeley Canvassing Hub starting at 11:30AM going till 12:30PM. Sign up to receive the location and then show up and grab a turf with other volunteers! This is part of our final Get Out The Vote push, and we need all hands on deck to flip HD64 for Mo!
